the atelectasis prone lung is a lung that is prone to develop atelectasis and that atelectasis itself is a major factor in the development of the acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS).

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of high frequency ventilation (HFV) in the atelectatic lung may be more than just a means to reduce peak pressures.
